nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable capping total Fuxi supply at 8888.
Private mapping(uint256 => uint256) storing block.timestamp per tokenId, used as the randomness seed source.
ReentrancyGuard status flag (1 = NOT_ENTERED, 2 = ENTERED) guarding nonReentrant functions.
Private owner address in Ownable, controls onlyOwner-gated functions.
ERC721 mapping(address => uint256) of token balances; incremented on mint and decremented on transfer/burn.
ERC721 mapping(uint256 => address) of token ownership.
ERC721Enumerable array of all token ids; its length is totalSupply().
Private array of the five-element characters used by pluck for trait generation.
Private array of the eight trigram characters used by pluck for trait generation.
Private array of the ten heavenly stems used by pluck for trait generation.
Private array of the twelve earthly branches used by pluck for trait generation.
Public payable-less nonReentrant mint entry point; computes tokenId = totalSupply()+1, enforces maxLimit, writes block.timestamp into numbers and mints to _msgSender().
Public view override building the on-chain SVG/JSON metadata by concatenating 60 string parts and Base64 encoding.
Internal view trait selector; reads numbers[tokenId], derives a pseudo-random index via keccak256 and returns sourceArray[rand % length].
Public view returning a Color struct chosen by rand % 100 derived from tokenId + numbers[tokenId].
Public view wrapper calling pluck with the FIVEELEMENTS prefix and fiveElements array.
Public view wrapper calling pluck with the GOSSIP prefix and gossip array.
Public view wrapper calling pluck with the TENDRY prefix and tenDry array.
Public view wrapper calling pluck with the EARTHLYBRANCH prefix and earthlyBranch array.
Internal pure keccak256-based pseudo-random helper: uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(input))).
Internal pure uint256 to decimal string converter using temp, digits and buffer loop.
Internal ERC721 safe mint: calls _mint then _checkOnERC721Received, invoking the receiver callback.
Internal ERC721 mint updating _balances and _owners and emitting Transfer.
Internal ERC721 transfer updating approvals, _balances[from] -= 1, _balances[to] += 1 and _owners[tokenId].
Private hook that performs an external try/catch onERC721Received call to the recipient contract and forwards reverts via assembly.
Public onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner through _setOwner.
Public onlyOwner function renouncing ownership by setting owner to address(0).
Public view returning _owner; used inside the onlyOwner check.
Internal view Context helper returning msg.sender; used for authorization decisions.
Private Ownable writer that updates _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
ReentrancyGuard modifier requiring _status != _ENTERED, setting _ENTERED before body and _NOT_ENTERED after.
Ownable modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(); the sole access-control gate in the codebase.
Attacker-controllable caller address surfaced through _msgSender().
Miner/validator-influenceable timestamp used as the on-chain randomness seed in claim().
State write numbers[tokenId] = block.timestamp inside claim(), making every token trait fully timestamp-dependent.
_safeMint performs an external call to the recipient; the mint-to-callback window is a reentrancy surface.
External IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received call with attacker-controlled receiver contract and attacker-controlled _data.
ERC721 balance increment/decrement arithmetic in _mint/_transfer/_burn.

Local keccak256-derived random value inside getBackGround.

Local Color struct returned by getBackGround and consumed by tokenURI.
Local string accumulated via chained abi.encodePacked calls in tokenURI.
Local string[60] memory parts holding the SVG fragments in tokenURI.

Local address oldOwner cached in _setOwner and emitted in OwnershipTransferred.

edges.reason: block.timestamp flows into claim() as the only entropy source for token traits, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
claim() stores block.timestamp into the numbers mapping (timestamp-dependency unsafe operation).
claim() writes numbers[tokenId] = block.timestamp, the seed later read by all trait getters.
maxLimit bounds the tokenId assigned in claim().
msg.sender decides who receives the minted token in claim(); the function has no allowlist or payment gate beyond nonReentrant.
claim() calls _safeMint, which reaches an external receiver callback before the transaction completes.
_safeMint triggers an external call to the recipient contract, the classic reentrancy window (mitigated by the nonReentrant guard on claim).
_safeMint delegates state changes to _mint before performing the receiver check.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received which calls out to the recipient.
_checkOnERC721Received performs an untrusted external onERC721Received call with attacker-controlled receiver and data.
_mint increments the _balances entry of the recipient.
_mint writes the new owner into the _owners mapping.
_transfer mutates both sender and recipient balances (subtraction and addition).
_transfer feeds the balance arithmetic operation node with attacker-influenced transfer parameters.
The balance arithmetic writes the resulting values back into the _balances mapping.
The nonReentrant modifier reads and writes the _status reentrancy lock.
The nonReentrant modifier guards claim(), blocking nested entry during the mint callback.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() to authorize the caller.
onlyOwner reads the owner() getter as the trusted reference address.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender used in all authorization checks.
transferOwnership delegates the privileged state change to _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the new privileged address into the _owner state variable.
tokenURI calls getBackGround to obtain palette and stroke attributes.
tokenURI embeds the getFiveElements trait into the SVG.
tokenURI embeds the getGossip trait into the SVG.
tokenURI embeds the getTenDry trait into the SVG.
tokenURI embeds the geTearthlyBranch trait into the SVG.
tokenURI converts tokenId through toString when building the metadata.
getFiveElements delegates trait selection to pluck.
getGossip delegates trait selection to pluck.
getTenDry delegates trait selection to pluck.
geTearthlyBranch delegates trait selection to pluck.
pluck calls random() to derive the pseudo-random index.
pluck reads numbers[tokenId] as the per-token seed value.
fiveElements array is read as sourceArray inside pluck.
gossip array is read as sourceArray inside pluck.
tenDry array is read as sourceArray inside pluck.
earthlyBranch array is read as sourceArray inside pluck.
getBackGround calls random() to derive the greatness value.
getBackGround reads numbers[tokenId] as part of its seed.
_checkOnERC721Received forwards _msgSender() as the operator argument to the receiver callback.
